task_completion.description: Weasis medical viewer is open with a CT series loaded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible, showing a DICOM image in the main viewport.

task_completion.description: Multiplanar Reconstruction (MPR) mode is activated for the series.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout changes from a single view to a multi-view display (typically showing Axial, Coronal, and Sagittal planes simultaneously) or the MPR icon is highlighted in the toolbar.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and focuses on the Coronal reconstruction view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A viewport labeled 'Coronal' or showing the coronal plane is active or selected for export.

task_completion.description: The Coronal view is exported to the specific file path '~/DICOM/exports/mpr_coronal.png'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or 'Save As' window shows the filename 'mpr_coronal.png' and the destination directory 'DICOM/exports'.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies and focuses on the Sagittal reconstruction view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A viewport labeled 'Sagittal' or showing the sagittal plane is active or selected for export.

task_completion.description: The Sagittal view is exported to the specific file path '~/DICOM/exports/mpr_sagittal.png'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or 'Save As' window shows the filename 'mpr_sagittal.png' and the destination directory 'DICOM/exports'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to generate the MPR views rather than terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement over Weasis menus/icons and the MPR interface, not just a terminal window executing 'cp' or 'mv' commands.

integrity.description: The exported images are actual reconstructions from the loaded volume.
integrity.visual_evidence: The viewports in the GUI show the reconstructed anatomy (Coronal/Sagittal) which differs from the original Axial source slices.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find and rename existing files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the 'Export' or 'Save' menus within the Weasis application.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task involves a synthetic 60-slice 256x256 DICOM volume. Valid MPR exports must be saved to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/mpr_coronal.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/mpr_sagittal.png. Each valid export should be at least 100x100 pixels and approximately 5KB or larger. The Coronal and Sagittal views are generated by the software from the Axial source; they should look like vertical cross-sections of the anatomy.
